#### Description
The new converter converts CoinAPI raw tick data files to LEAN format (`Tick`, `Second` and `Minute` resolutions).
Only data for supported exchanges will be imported (CoinBasePro and Bitfinex).

#### Related Issue
Closes #3198 

#### Motivation and Context
Historical trades and quotes for more Crypto exchanges.

#### Requires Documentation Change
Readme file for ToolBox has been updated.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
This has been tested with the provided sample data file, containing CoinbasePro/GDAX data (all symbols for a single date).

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)

issue_context.title: Add CoinApiDataConverter ToolBox application
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
The converter should be able to convert CoinAPI raw data files to LEAN format.
The input files will contain tick data for trades and quotes.
The output files will be LEAN zip files for `Tick`, `Second` and `Minute` resolutions.

#### Actual Behavior
Not implemented.

#### Potential Solution
Implement the converter as a ToolBox application: `CoinApiDataConverter`

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
